title: Northstar Data Retention Standard
subtitle: Revision 1 | Fictional demonstration material
sections: This standard describes routine retention periods for the fictional Northstar Field Services environment.
Daily operational backups are retained for 30 days. A restore request must identify the target service, requested recovery point, and approving service owner.
Customer archives are retained for 365 days unless a signed customer agreement specifies a different period. Legal holds override routine deletion schedules and require review by the records owner.
At the end of the applicable retention period, the storage owner schedules deletion and records completion in the service change log.
